author: Awesomerthanpie
quote: Looka the directors cut is some unnessecary cutscenes on top of a 10/10 game. I am gonna take this as a review of yakuza which is a phenomenal game. Absolute gem. Cannot recommend higher. Truly never felt more emotional in a story nor cared about the characters than this. Great intro piece to a great series. Combat great, side content is fun.

author: Awesomerthanpie
quote: Writing much worse than its predecessor. Characters bland. Cant believe I wasted my money on this when I could have been playing GTA 5 or any of the open world exploration games released since that have good world building.
